rows.label: Warm model and pipelines, fresh uncached prompts, final K=1 + lookahead 1 + flush 32 stack under sustained background CPU load, paired live against the published path
rows.statistic: Median of eight rotating paired observations; each observation resets KV state and uses a different prompt. Ratio is the median of per-round ratios against the live published baseline.

pairedSpeedup.baseline: published WebLLM 0.2.84 runtime and published (stock, self-compiled) model library; 74.885 tok/s median in this run
pairedSpeedup.candidate: this entry's model library, K=1 burst, GPU lookahead 1, batch pass, flush 32

quality.freshPromptExact: 8/8 outputs byte-identical to the paired published baseline in the same round, with equal completion-token counts, cycling through all six fresh prompts
quality.pairedEndToEndNote: End-to-end (TTFT + decode) against the same published baseline exceeded the pre-lookahead K=4/flush-32 stack's end-to-end ratio (1.229x median) in every one of the 8 rounds.

rows.notes: 9.7404 ms/token is the reciprocal of the measured 102.665 tokens/s median. The same rotation also measured a pre-lookahead K=4/flush-32 stack at 95.73 tok/s, 1.273x published, 8/8 exact -- kept as the baseline the lookahead adoption decision is measured against, not a separate catalog entry.

rows.label: GPU lookahead second pass: K=1 lookahead 1 paired live against the K=4/flush-32 pre-lookahead winner, same model library and runtime bundle
rows.statistic: Medians of per-round ratios against the live K=4/flush-32 sibling stack: fresh run, 8 rounds (load 14.87-20.02); quality-corpus run, 4 rounds (load 14.6-15.03).

quality.freshPromptExact: 8/8 fresh outputs byte-identical to the paired live K=4 baseline
quality.qualityCorpusExact: 4/4 quality outputs plus the fresh convert item byte-identical to the live K=4 baseline, every one of 4 rounds

rows.notes: Decode gain (1.068x, IQR clear of parity) clears the 1.05x adoption bar the 8B pass's 1.043x missed. The next-request TTFT cost (+7.7ms average) is the same orphaned-speculative-step mechanism documented for the 8B pass, but smaller in absolute terms because a MiniCPM5-2B decode step (~10.4ms) is itself much shorter than 8B's (~19ms). Paired end-to-end stays net positive on both the fresh corpus (1.031x) and the quality corpus (1.022x), unlike the 8B pass's flat 1.006x fresh-corpus result. Decision: adopted -- see row 1's pairedEndToEndNote for the decisive published-path comparison.

publishedLive.notes: Paired eight-round published WebLLM 0.2.84 baseline (stock, self-compiled model library) under sustained background CPU load, measured live in the same rotation as this entry.

preLookaheadWinnerLive.notes: K=4, batch pass, flush 32, same model library, measured live in the same rotation as this entry; 1.273x the published baseline. Kept as the pre-lookahead baseline this entry's adoption decision is measured against; not a separate catalog entry.

caveat: Absolute measured throughput was taken while other agents' work continued concurrently on the shared machine. The paired ratio is the robust headline. There is no historical quiet MiniCPM5-2B number and no quiet projection is claimed.
